title: PADMM / DVI：倾斜导轨滑块与地面接触
question: 在同一带五个双边约束与接触不等式的最小机械系统中，两种公开默认配置组能否保持导轨约束、处理落地并复现？

scene.joint: world-to-body passive prismatic; parent frame at initial body origin; child frame identity

A.description: public PADMM defaults: dense Jacobian/dynamics, preconditioning on, LLTB, max_iterations=200, default acceleration and container warmstart

B.description: public DVI defaults: sparse Jacobian, dense dynamics, preconditioning off, LLTBRCM dynamics, max_alternating_iterations=24 with 2 inequality sweeps, default container warmstart

intervention_scope: A backend CONFIGURATION GROUP comparison; dependent defaults, warmstart details, regularization and iteration schedules may differ. Full requested/resolved configs and all diffs are archived. Not a single-factor dynamics_solver-only intervention; no equal-iteration or speed ranking.
configuration_validation: Both configs retain both padmm and dvi subcontainers with identical saved values; selecting the backend activates different schedules. Requested and resolved differences must be exactly the four allowed paths. Validate PADMM sparse_jacobian=False/preconditioning=True/LLTB, DVI sparse_jacobian=True/preconditioning=False/LLTBRCM, both sparse_dynamics=False and integrator=euler. Any extra difference is a protocol violation and reported, not silently ignored.

reference.formula: a_parallel=dot(g,axis)=7.848 m/s2; p(t)=p0+0.5*a_parallel*t^2*axis; v(t)=a_parallel*t*axis. Independent continuous mechanics reference; first-order Euler position error allowed.
reference.geometry: sphere-floor penetration=max(0,radius-z); off-axis distance=norm((p-p0)-axis*dot(p-p0,axis)); quaternion identity angular deviation; kinetic plus m*g*z potential energy

evidence_validity: same A/B initial state and mass/inertia arrays
all 145 state samples and 144 status samples present and finite
both independent repeats meet absolute/relative tolerance
actual terminal iterations become positive and internal model_active_contacts becomes positive
acceptance.criterion_rationale: Precontact Euler truncation bound is 0.5*a_parallel*t*dt=0.00327m at 0.2s, hence 0.004m; velocity is constant-acceleration reference. Guide/rotation bounds are absolute SI errors at one-body float32 scale. 15mm permits roughly two contact-time vertical increments (~7.4mm each), but catches unresolved penetration. Tail 10mm/0.05m/s and energy +0.05J are scenario-specific, predeclared physical limits, not solver tolerances.
acceptance.pair_comparison: Report complete differences; no required winner or minimum effect. Physical pass/fail is judged per backend. Tail position difference <=0.005m and velocity difference <=0.02m/s support only narrow agreement; disagreement is a valid negative result, not grounds to change protocol.
acceptance.terminal_convergence: Record fraction and all r_p/r_d/r_c arrays separately. Do not compare same-named residuals as identical or use converged alone as physical correctness. Physical criteria may fail despite converged. No universal common residual acceptance threshold.

residuals.PADMM: r_p physical impulse consensus; r_d physical velocity weighted ADMM change; r_c inequality complementarity J
residuals.DVI: r_p unilateral cone projection distance in impulse; r_d dual-cone distance/bilateral velocity violation; r_c inequality complementarity J

instrumentation: Scenario and SolverKamino construction use public APIs. Read-only solver._config and solver._contacts_kamino.model_active_contacts are version-pinned internal instrumentation, not public API promises.
failure_policy: Every attempt gets an immutable run directory. Runtime failure, nonfinite states, criterion failure and disagreement are retained and reported. Fixing an implementation mistake requires a new runner hash and explicit exclusion reason; changing scene/config/criteria requires a new protocol version before rerun. No posthoc threshold relaxation.
limitations: one CPU world and one sphere with a passive prismatic guide
one contact patch, no contact-rich stack or closed loop
default backend configuration groups only; no DVI Schur/sparse-dynamics or PADMM branch sweep
no GPU, performance ranking or long-horizon stability claim
friction cone present but this is not a friction coefficient calibration experiment
